sceneV2BoundedItems.item: 1 — common-only planned/unverified guide, and the real survey glyph grammar
implemented: commonGroundState.ts: commonGroundReferenceHeld(snapshot, workerAt) requires stage holding-h AND a real recorded/live pose within 0.25 units of H; commonGroundCommonDisplay returns none | planned-guide | tested-common. Both are pure reads that write nothing.

The guide starts at ACTUAL H arrival only. It stays planned through Terra passage and through the worker test (stages positioning-to-e and testing), and only common.committed — his actual final arrival after all eighteen units, with her reciprocal passage already proved — promotes it to paired tested geometry.

commonGroundRoute.ts: pure traceGlyphs / commonGuideGlyphs / commonTestedGlyphs / sampleRouteEvenly. Proposed = one short bar along the recorded local segment; tested = two parallel bars with a visible gap; a held endpoint REPLACES its pair with two separated transverse half-bars around an open centre; the guide is one thin continuous bar per existing polyline segment.

Corner bars bisect the actual recorded incoming/outgoing segments and are clamped to real local spacing (never an enlarged axis-aligned square). Every recorded sample is represented; nothing is decimated.

CommonGroundWorld.tsx: the whole 512-instance matrix buffer is written and uploaded at MOUNT with instances parked at zero scale, so no verb frame first-uses an instance. The layout is recomputed only when a sample, tested prefix, real hold, display state or live terrain revision actually changed — a resting frame does no work and allocates nothing.

Allocation: accepted survey and working proposal are drawn TOGETHER (128 samples x 2 glyphs each = 512 exactly). The common display uses the RELEASED working allocation and is drawn only while no proposal owns it, so an optional repeat takes the allocation back without losing accepted facts.

The guide is grounded live: firstUnsupportedSegment over the same footing and solids the director uses truncates it at the first genuinely unsupported segment and terminates it with the open transverse stop, rather than floating over an edited hole or replanning around one.
No new resource, route, save slot, objective, anchor or cue was added. Geometry, material, program and light budgets are unchanged (one instanced mesh, one prewarmed material, depth test on).
sceneV2BoundedItems.notClaimed: No rendered, night, mobile, reduced-motion, lowest-tier or hardware readability evidence. No measured draw/program/storage delta.

movieRepair.summary: The ch13 rail no longer holds the screening cadence the shared performer owns, and it follows an authored polyline in order with honest reconstruction instead of rescanning it statelessly each frame. Movement precision was corrected so ordinary walking satisfies the existing physical proofs: turning vertices are walked through rather than cut, the survey recording begins at the authored start, and each plan carries the stop radius its own goal needs. lifecycleRepair.summary: Three causal integration defects repaired under the unchanged signed contract. The two Origin audit-site beats no longer boot inside the landed Kestrel: the deep-link seeding owner now restores on-foot control ownership, and the screening rail can leave a landed ship rather than stalling. The chapter reads the actual physical body: one conversion from the Rapier capsule centre to the grounded body origin along the live local up now feeds route recording, supported ground, sockets, occupancy, clearance, arrival and progress alike - which also repaired the footing query that had been silently refusing the survey start, every trace sample and both reference offers. Signed anchors the contract declares conditional are no longer prerequisites for the ones after them, a refused activation is retried once at the entry seam instead of being spent, and the live install receipt is published before the steady entry it causes. No predicate, threshold, radius or proof condition was relaxed and no protected file was edited.

worldRepair.summary: VF3-FOOTING-1 root cause established from the real generator: the live footing read generator.shouldVoxelExist OUTSIDE the rendered cube (radius 25) and treated the phantom cell 26 as an invisible ceiling above the ground the body stood on. Repaired by clipping the procedural fallback only (real placed voxels still carry and obstruct anywhere) and adding an actual contact band so a still-cell-25 hover is not grounded. VF3-AVHOME-1 root cause established from the real boot ordering: the ch13-home entry anchor is published synchronously before the first frame, and world-gen/shader-warmup reports itself to the chapter as pause, which cleared it. Repaired with a bounded one-anchor beat-entry queue that survives pause and visibility loss only. VF3-CG008-1 demonstrated as a real failure through the actual WorldSave validator/serializer/restore and repaired by extending the existing transaction-chain doctrine to validated, actor- and world-scoped saved survey state. All three proven necessary by exact-byte counterfactuals with no destructive Git. Full suite 349 files / 3091 tests, typecheck, build and the static registry/journey/story-UX/AV/authority checks all exit 0. No hardware, browser, movie, visual or audio acceptance is claimed.
